description: Check a wallet's USDC/USDT balances on every network a pay link takes with a connected wallet, with each network's fee and whether the wallet holds enough gas. Defaults to this agent's wallet. Read-only; the address isn't stored.

address.description: EVM wallet to scan. Omit to scan this agent's own wallet.

link_id.description: The pay-link id whose networks to check.
